requirements: each envelope binds exact argv cwd timeout subject digest role and session
required commands cannot be skipped substituted or delegated to a different role
commands execute only after a sealed Gate Run Manifest exists
shell expansion and undeclared subprocesses are forbidden
read and write paths are repository-relative and manifest declared
governing assets and sealed evidence are read-only to Candidate Builder and Conductor
customer and production filesystems are forbidden
pre and post tree digests and final clean status are retained
each allowed host method and purpose is explicit in the envelope
M-1 permits only read-only public documentation source release and license retrieval
provider mutation runtime dispatch deployment and release endpoints are forbidden
all undeclared egress is denied
provider customer and production credentials are forbidden
synthetic credentials are attempt scoped and redacted

GitHub owner or ruleset-administration authority belongs only to the stable-authority publisher and is never inherited by Builder Reviewer Validator Conductor Approver Definition Issuer Candidate or generic automation
authority and effect credentials remain separate
one envelope binds one principal session role subject and attempt
host mounts sockets secrets and undeclared environment variables are denied
fresh Reviewer and one-time Validator sessions are mandatory
conflicting roles require both principal_id and session_id to differ
raw stdout stderr exit status timestamps and tool versions are retained
Evidence and verdict records bind Gate Run Manifest Candidate and Governing Definition digests
historical attempts are append-only and never overwritten
secrets are redacted with a separate attestation

forbidden_effects: External Runtime Provider Task Agent Squad Issue Workspace or Projection mutation without separately required product Grant
provider installation or authentication outside an expressly approved later qualification
push deploy publish release or Actions enablement unless separately and exactly authorized
using an Envelope as Capability Snapshot Adapter Qualification Runtime Qualification or product Execution Evidence
Candidate modification of governing refs tags definitions approvals evidence or verdicts
activation_requirements: active protected governance ref and tag
credential isolation evidence for each role
